_comment: Android SPEC — what a player buys. identity + personality traits + capabilities + commerce. traits DERIVE the mechanics (see main.cpp): neediness -> longing fill/call, intimacy -> intimate-clip gate. Put explicit overrides in `tuning` only when you want to bypass the trait-derived values.

capabilities._chroma_note: Key color for her composited clips. Ada rendered on GREEN. Options: white | green | magenta.
capabilities._audio_note: Ada's clips are near-silent, so audio stays off.
capabilities._emotions_note: The ONLY emotions the model may pick — exactly the clips she has (neutral is implicit -> default.mp4).
